commentary.text: 90+6' Jose Guzman is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
90+4' Jose Guzman has a clear sight and sees a foul from Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao).
90+4' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+3' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 5:1.
90+3' The attendance for today's match is 29043.
90+2' We will have 5 min. of added time.

90+2' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top right corner, but Inaki Pena thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
89' Substitution. John Donald (Elche) on for Alvaro Nunez.
89' Here is a change. German Valera is going off and Eder Sarabia gives the last tactical orders to Josan (Elche).
89' The game is interrupted as German Valera (Elche) is flagged offside.
87' The players claim that Rafa Mir (Elche) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
85' Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Unai Simon is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
83' A yellow card for a tackle by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao). Jose Guzman doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
83' Dangerous play by Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao). Jose Guzman blows his whistle for a foul.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aymeric Laporte leaves the pitch and Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
81' Victor Chust (Elche) climbs above the defence to meet the free kick, but plants his header high over the bar from close range.
80' Elche are awarded a free kick. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
79' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
77' 11:15 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
77' Rafa Mir (Elche) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Guzman has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
75' Here comes a substitution. Marc Aguado is given a rest as he is replaced by Rodrigo Mendoza (Elche).
75' The cross into the penalty area from Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
75' Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
73' The game is interrupted now, Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
72' Marc Aguado (Elche) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
69' Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and Jose Guzman blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta comes off the pitch to be replaced by Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao).

67' Rafa Mir (Elche) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
67' Victor Chust (Elche) latches on to an accurate cross on the edge of the penalty box and sends the ball towards goal, but it's too easy for the keeper.
66' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
65' Rafa Mir (Elche) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
62' Leo Petrot will be replaced by Adria Pedrosa (Elche).
61' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jose Guzman didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
61' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jose Guzman blows his whistle for an infringement.
61' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Inaki Pena intercepts the ball.
60' The corner kick from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

60' Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
59' It is time for a substitution. Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) is on for Oihan Sancet.
58' Rafa Mir (Elche) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
56' The Elche players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
55' Aleix Febas (Elche) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
55' Corner kick. Elche will have an opportunity. Rafa Mir (Elche) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
52' Rafa Mir (Elche) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross.
52' Rough tackle by Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
49' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jose Guzman who sees an offensive foul.
47' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
46' Half-time substitution. Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) is replaced by Nico Williams.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) is replaced by Inaki Williams.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' Jose Guzman has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' The corner is swung in but Elche can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45+3' A lofted cross from Marc Aguado (Elche) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
45+2' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45+1' Jose Guzman blows his whistle for a foul after Leo Petrot (Elche) hacks down one of his opponents.
44' German Valera (Elche) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jose Guzman ignores the protests.
43' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) makes a strong challenge and Jose Guzman blows for a foul.
41' Rafa Mir (Elche) receives a lofted pass from out wide and shoots from close range, but the ball flies way over the crossbar.
40' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
39' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jose Guzman shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Eder Sarabia (Elche) is the recipient.
35' Good movement by Rafa Mir (Elche), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
33' Elche are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
32' A pass by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
29' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) looks relieved after the referee decides on no action against him after the VAR review.
29' Jose Guzman shows a yellow card to Victor Chust (Elche) for a tough tackle.
28' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao)! Let's see what he decides.
27' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Guzman blows for a foul.
25' Andre Silva (Elche) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Elche comes to nothing.

21' Rafa Mir (Elche) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Unai Simon guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

19' Rafa Mir (Elche) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Unai Simon, who makes a glorious save!
17' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is able to continue to play.
16' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
16' The game is interrupted. Leo Petrot (Elche) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
14' Elche take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
13' German Valera (Elche) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Elche have been awarded a corner kick.
12' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
11' Aleix Febas (Elche) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
8' Elche keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
6' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) commits a rough foul. Jose Guzman stops the game and makes a call.
4' Ath Bilbao are ruled offside.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Elche will have the kick-off.
Jose Guzman will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
